why: Wrote B1's laws of docs/plan/quests/sev-runbooks-PLAN.md in today's lead tooling and kalfa/records: R6 in pr/Merge.test.ts, R7 and R9 in sev/scripts/Incident.test.ts, R8 in sev/scripts/Freeze.test.ts, R11 in kalfa/records/src/Runbooks.test.ts, and the package.json line that makes pnpm lint run records check runbook. R10 and every B2 file are not in this round. Each is red against the product as it stands: R6 because Route has no sev1 or sev0Fixes and a sev0 fix behind main is admitted; R7 because Incident.fix is not a function; R8 because the verdict cancels main's check push run; R9 because close dispatches nothing (and the old nextLines still tells the lead to start the full run by hand); R11 because Runbooks.ts does not exist. Every older law in those files stays green. No product file was touched.
note: A first tests agent's work was cut off by a container restart before it committed, and this agent took it over: it kept R8's verdict law, R9's scenarios, R7's walk and R11's laws after reading each, rewrote R6 (a sev0 now tells a fix from a ready pull request, and a ready one needs no catch-up) and fixed R11's CLI law (its fixture lacked the records the runbook follows, and its decision numbers could collide with them). It dropped R11's claim that a bare records check runs the runbook check, which the plan does not say. To prove each law can go green and fail, this agent built the product in scratch copies of .agents/skills/sev, .agents/skills/lead/scripts and kalfa/records under the worktree, ran the plants there, and deleted the copies; no product file was edited. The plants below name that scratch build. Node 26.13.0 was fetched outside the repo because the container has Node 22. Started and ended are estimates; usage and cost are not recorded. pnpm lint is red only on the new records check runbook line (records has no runbook check yet) and its promise-types part was killed for memory once and passed alone.
